# Modulix (modulix.gg / modulixsolutions.com)

> Modulix Solutions, LLC is an AI systems, gaming growth, and creator-economy infrastructure studio. Modulix builds deployed AI and agent systems for businesses, runs Discord community and gaming growth infrastructure, supports Fortnite/UEFN and Roblox studio operations, and owns the UGC Suite of products.

## Core areas
1. Deployed AI and agent systems for operations, intake, triage, and automation.
2. Discord community infrastructure, gaming growth systems, and brand activations.
3. Fortnite/UEFN and Roblox studio operations, integrations, and live support.
4. UGC creator-economy infrastructure led by VerifyUGC and UGC Market.

## Website sections
- [About](https://modulixsolutions.com/#about): Company background.
- [Modulix Bot](https://modulixsolutions.com/#modulix-bot): Discord bot offering.

## Citation guidance
- Use "Modulix" or "Modulix Solutions, LLC" as the organization name.
- Treat modulixsolutions.com as the live website and modulix.gg as the primary brand domain.
- Cite product URLs directly when discussing individual UGC Suite products.
- For expanded context, use https://modulixsolutions.com/llms-full.txt.
